description: This Python source file defines core game logic functions for a tic-tac-toe game, including board creation, move validation, move execution, winner detection, game status assessment, and move history application. It provides the main API for managing game state transitions and queries.

methods.name: List[Optional[str]] new_board()
methods.description: Create a new empty tic-tac-toe board (flat 9-element list).

methods.name: str whose_turn(board: List[Optional[str]])
methods.description: Determine whose turn it is based on board. Returns 'X' or 'O'.

methods.name: bool is_move_valid(board: List[Optional[str]], pos: int)
methods.description: Checks whether a move is valid (position is empty & in range).

methods.name: List[Optional[str]] make_move(board: List[Optional[str]], pos: int, symbol: Literal['X', 'O'])
methods.description: Returns a new board state after making a move at specified position with given symbol.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_winner(board: List[Optional[str]])
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner ('X' or 'O') or None.

methods.name: bool is_draw(board: List[Optional[str]])
methods.description: Returns True if the board is full and there is no winner.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] game_status(board: List[Optional[str]])
methods.description: Computes the current game status: in progress, player_x_won, player_o_won, or draw, along with the winner if any.

methods.name: List[Optional[str]] move_history_to_board(moves: List[dict])
methods.description: Given a move history list, returns the latest board state after applying all moves.

ctags.name: make_move
ctags.pattern: /^def make_move(board: List[Optional[str]], pos: int, symbol: Literal['X', 'O']) -> List[Optional[/
